shutdown_path.accepted_means: latched request, not completed physical shutdown
shutdown_path.sit_path: play peck nonblocking, begin_shutdown_sit, wait 2*sitstand_ramp_s, cut torque, poweroff
shutdown_path.no_sit_path: cut torque, play peck blocking up to 1500ms, disable policy, poweroff
shutdown_path.audio_conditions: audio enabled, peck bank available and aplay/ALSA working; no audio success receipt
shutdown_path.poweroff: robotd root unit calls setsid sh -c systemctl poweroff
shutdown_path.controller_client_change: Send same IPC only; do not precede with relax, do not replay/fallback to OS poweroff, do not synthesize audio or fixed client waits
shutdown_path.important_limit: IPC accepted does not prove control thread progressed, sound played, torque cut or OS powered off; missing daemon must be surfaced as error
